scope: Static original-PNG anatomy review only; no GUI, battle, save reads, repository changes. Ten non-protagonist appearances x four frames. Manual approximate search ROIs; inspect actual alpha contour before converting to acceptance witnesses.
coordinateContract: Inclusive physical pixels local to each unmirrored frame, NOT map pixels. map-source offset = (localPixel-anchor)*physicalToSourceScale; negate x for facing -1.
uncertainty: F1/F3 walk poses show raised boots and toe-up soles. A static transparent frame cannot prove gait contact time or ground plane. Preserve uncertain candidates separately; do not treat excluding them as a passing guarantee. Multiple boots/wheels have perspective-different y.

rois.note: Manual anatomical search window. Edge is alpha-derived within window, not certified contact at every x. Do not use raised or uncertain windows to shrink acceptance.
